articles.title: President Names Jay Clayton to Lead New White House AI Group
articles.summary: President Trump named Jay Clayton, the director of national intelligence, to lead a new White House group about advanced AI.

articles.title: Brazil's Presidential Election Heads to a Run-Off
articles.summary: No one won more than half the votes in Brazil's first round, so Flávio Bolsonaro and President Lula will face off on October 25.

articles.title: Bosnia Holds Elections as Leader Declares Victory for His Party
articles.summary: A Bosnian Serb leader declared victory for his party while votes were still being counted.
